title: Amed vs Nusa Penida: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Nusa Penida for dramatic scenery and manta rays; Amed for authentic shore diving and local village atmosphere. Do both with 7+ days in Bali.

categories.name: Diving (variety)
categories.summary: Nusa Penida has 20+ dive sites, guaranteed mantas, and mola mola. Amed has excellent shore diving and the USAT Liberty Wreck.

categories.name: Snorkeling
categories.summary: Amed wins for easy, calm snorkeling with turtles right off the beach.

categories.name: Beaches & Scenery
categories.summary: Kelingking, Broken Beach, and Diamond Beach are among the most dramatic in Southeast Asia.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Amed is one easy coastal road. Nusa Penida has terrible roads and no ride-hailing.

categories.name: Budget
categories.summary: Amed is 15-20% cheaper day-to-day, with no ferry cost.

categories.name: Crowds
categories.summary: Amed is quiet and authentic. Nusa Penidas top viewpoints are very crowded in peak season.

categories.name: Manta Rays
categories.summary: Manta Bay at Nusa Penida offers near-guaranteed manta ray sightings year-round.

categories.name: Vibe
categories.summary: Amed is an authentic fishing village. Nusa Penida is increasingly tourism-oriented.

faq.question: Is Amed or Nusa Penida better for diving?
faq.answer: Nusa Penida for experienced divers wanting mantas and mola mola. Amed for beginners and easy shore diving.

faq.question: How do you get to Nusa Penida?
faq.answer: Fast boat from Sanur harbor, 45-60 minutes, IDR 175,000-200,000 (~-12) one way.

faq.question: Can you do both Amed and Nusa Penida?
faq.answer: Yes. Route: Nusa Penida (3 nights) → Sanur → Amed (2-3 nights). No direct boat between them; must go through Sanur.
